title: Display affinity behavior has no included regression coverage
reasoning: The feature implements multi-branch display selection with sender-window preference, visible surface fallback, and stored affinity fallback, plus mutable module-level cached affinity. No linked tests are included for this feature, while the package has a Jest test entrypoint available. A regression here can route screenshots, overlay placement, or window fitting to the wrong monitor, especially on multi-display setups where stale stored affinity and visible-window selection interact.
recommendation: Add focused Jest coverage for active display selection: visible sender window wins, hidden sender falls back to visible chat/main, no visible surfaces falls back to stored affinity, and sync only updates stored affinity when a visible target resolves.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no tests, and the included files contain only implementation plus the package-level Jest command, so there is no first-class evidence of intended behavior being asserted.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a frontend Jest test for display_affinity_runtime.cjs using fake screen, BrowserWindow.fromWebContents, chatWindow, and mainWindow objects to exercise the active-surface and stored-affinity fallback matrix.
minimumFixScope: Add tests under the existing frontend Jest setup; no production code change is required unless the tests expose incorrect behavior.
